today.title: This is your day as a clock
today.body:
Midnight is at the top and it runs clockwise. The blue hand is now; the greyed part has passed.

Tap anywhere to continue

today.body: Sleep, work, travel and daily routines. Nothing gets planned here.

today.body: Green blocks are sessions, peach ones are meals. Tap one to open it. Gaps are free time.

today.title: The middle tells you what to do now
today.body: How long is left, what’s next, and a heads-up in amber before something starts or ends.

today.title: Ready? Press Start
today.body: Start runs a timer. Done logs it straight away.

today.title: Plans changed?
today.body: Tap Something came up. Only what’s affected moves, with no penalty. Tap ? at the top to see this again.
